# determinacy model

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:determinacyModel`](gmeow-determinacyModel.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/determinacyModel>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)
- **Box roles:** [CBox role](../boxes/cbox.md), [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Relates a reference frame to its default determinacy model.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:ReferenceFrame`](../classes/gmeow-ReferenceFrame.md) -> [`gmeow:Determinacy`](../classes/gmeow-Determinacy.md); functional

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:determinacyModel`](gmeow-determinacyModel.md) from [`gmeow:ReferenceFrame`](../classes/gmeow-ReferenceFrame.md) to [`gmeow:Determinacy`](../classes/gmeow-Determinacy.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

### Flashback

- **Source:** [`slices/extensions/narrative/examples/flashback.ttl`](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/slices/extensions/narrative/examples/flashback.ttl)

```turtle
# --- The continuity (story world) — a NarrativeReferenceFrame.
ex:canon a gmeow:NarrativeReferenceFrame ;
    rdfs:label          "Lighthouse Saga continuity"@en ;
    gmeow:frameRealm    gmeow:frameRealmNarrative ;
    gmeow:hasAxis       ex:narrativeOrder ;
    gmeow:dimensionCount "1"^^xsd:nonNegativeInteger ;
    gmeow:frameKind     gmeow:frameKindNarrative ;
    gmeow:requiresHost  false ;
    gmeow:determinacyModel gmeow:determinacyDisputed .

# --- DISCOURSE-time frame: the order of telling, owned by the novel.
ex:discourseFrame a gmeow:NarrativeTimeFrame ;
    rdfs:label           "telling order of the novel"@en ;
    gmeow:narrativeTimeAxis gmeow:axisDiscourseTime ;
    gmeow:discourseTimeOf ex:novel ;
    gmeow:frameRealm     gmeow:frameRealmNarrative ;
    gmeow:hasAxis        ex:narrativeOrder ;
    gmeow:dimensionCount "1"^^xsd:nonNegativeInteger ;
    gmeow:frameKind      gmeow:frameKindNarrative ;
    gmeow:requiresHost   false ;
    gmeow:determinacyModel gmeow:determinacyDisputed .
```

## Common Companion Terms

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use for a reference frame's default determinacy model; functional.

### Avoid when

- Avoid using it for a per-value determinacy (that is [`gmeow:hasDeterminacy`](gmeow-hasDeterminacy.md) on the value) — this is the frame-level default.

### How to use

- Set one [`gmeow:Determinacy`](../classes/gmeow-Determinacy.md) individual as the frame default; individual values may still override via [`gmeow:hasDeterminacy`](gmeow-hasDeterminacy.md).

### Examples

- ex:slamFrame [`gmeow:determinacyModel`](gmeow-determinacyModel.md) [`gmeow:determinacyProbabilistic`](../individuals/gmeow-determinacyProbabilistic.md).
